description: Lumma logs are recognized across `information.txt`, `system.txt`, `system_info.txt`, and `userinformation.txt` by shared fields including `LummaC2 Build`, `LID`, `HWID`, and CPU details. The observed `Time` value ends with a `(sig:<UNIX>.<hex>)` marker.
name: Lumma
targets: 2FA seeds from Authy and similar desktop clients
Crypto wallet extensions (focus on MetaMask, Phantom, and similar)
Cryptocurrency seed phrases harvested from text files
